title: Home EV charger – charge when electricity is cheapest | VOOL
description: A 22 kW smart charger for your house, with an app that follows electricity prices and saves up to 30% on charging.

sections.title: Plug in at home. Pay less for every kilometre.
sections.lead: The VOOL Charger and the free app charge your car when electricity is cheapest, and have it ready when you leave.
sections.alt: Family charging an electric car at home in winter

items.title: Up to 30% cheaper
items.text: The app checks prices for the next 24 hours and picks the cheapest hours.

items.title: Safe for your fuse box
items.text: Add a VOOL LMC and the charger shares power with the heating, the stove and other appliances without tripping a fuse.

items.title: Built to last
items.text: IP55, IK10 and −30 °C to +55 °C, with a 5-year warranty.

sections.title: Plug in at six. Charging starts when prices drop.
sections.text: The car waits through the evening price peak and charges in the cheapest hours of the night. It is ready at the time you set.
sections.note: Example hourly prices in ct/kWh, not live data.

sections.alt: Parent and child plugging in a car
sections.title: Set it once
sections.text: Tell the app when the car should be ready and how full. It handles the rest and shows what each session cost.

sections.title: Lithuania: get paid for charging at home

items.title: 3.9 ct for every kWh
items.text: With DAEI, VOOL pays you for the electricity you charge at home. The rate is fixed for 12 months.

sections.title: Buy from a partner near you
sections.lead: VOOL does not install chargers itself. Our partners sell and install.
